news.headline: Pakistan eyes $1-2bn return to global capital markets
news.summary: Per Mettis Global, Pakistan is targeting $1-2bn in borrowing from global debt markets during the current fiscal year and preparing bond issuances arranged by consortiums including Standard Chartered and Citi, alongside a proposed $10bn US swap line (Finance Minister Aurangzeb - relates to the already-logged Aug 19 $10bn Exchange Stabilisation Support Facility request) intended as a confidence signal for investors. Also cites a planned $750m panda bond (renminbi) issuance and potential Boeing aircraft financing benefiting Pakistan International Airlines. FY26 trade deficit put at $39.5bn (four-year high); total outstanding external debt $129.7bn as of 2024, 23% owed to China. No transaction confirmed or priced yet - pending plans. Logged as impact 3 (notable macro financing development, not yet a confirmed deal), per desk criteria Rule 10.

news.headline: Petrol price rises Rs1.12, HSD by Rs1.11 per litre, effective Aug 26-27
news.summary: Per an OGRA notification issued Tuesday under the daily petroleum-pricing mechanism, petrol rose Rs1.12/litre to Rs343.10/litre and High-Speed Diesel (HSD) rose Rs1.11/litre to Rs371.80/litre, effective Aug 26-27, 2026 (PSX/SBP closed Aug 26 for Eid Milad-un-Nabi, already logged). Dealer margins fixed at Rs9.98/litre on both products; Petroleum Levy Rs80/litre on each. Follows the already-logged Aug 24 adjustment (petrol +Rs3.81, HSD +Rs3.59). Logged as impact 2 (minor, routine daily adjustment), consistent with prior similarly small moves under this mechanism.

news.headline: PSX shrugs off uncertainty as Asim Munir's Iran visit revives US-Tehran de-escalation hopes
news.summary: Additional driver detail for the already-logged Tue Aug 25, 2026 confirmed close (177,370.70/177,370.71, +404.02pts/+0.23%): per Business Recorder and Dawn.com, the session's gain was attributed to renewed hopes of US-Iran de-escalation following Field Marshal Asim Munir's one-day visit to Tehran (meetings with President Pezeshkian and FM Araghchi), with Iranian officials calling the talks a 'valuable diplomatic gain' per Pakistan Today. This geopolitical driver was not previously captured in the newslog entry for this close, which cited only Moody's rating upgrade. No new index figure or ticker; tagged MACRO only, impact 3 consistent with the already-logged close entry.

news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 ends flat amid late selling
news.summary: KSE-100 confirmed close Thu Aug 27, 2026 (first session after Wed Aug 26 Eid Milad-un-Nabi holiday, already logged) at 177,322.77, down 47.93 points (-0.03%) from Tue Aug 25's confirmed close of 177,370.70 (already logged), per Business Recorder ('PSX: KSE-100 ends flat amid late selling') and The Express Tribune ('PSX up 800 points after holiday reopen'). Index opened strongly and hit an intraday high of 178,650.01 (+1,279pts/+0.72%) before sustained afternoon selling erased the gains. Volume 611.6m shares, value Rs34.5bn. Per Tribune: positive contributors HUBC, ENGROH, POL, UBL and FFC added ~494 points collectively; negative contributors NBP, PPL, PSO, OGDC and SYS erased ~615 points on profit-taking. Sub-1% net move; impact 3 (notable), consistent with prior similar-magnitude index-close entries in this newslog.

news.headline: IT exports eye the next leap
news.summary: Pakistan's IT export receipts stood at $417m in July 2026, up 18% year-on-year and broadly unchanged from $416m in June, the second-highest monthly figure in the recent series after $437m in Dec-25, per Business Recorder's BR Research. Sector-wide item, no single listed-company figure disclosed. Logged as impact 2 (minor, informational sector/economic item).

news.headline: Privatisation Commission shortlists 10 bidders for FESCO; Lucky Cement-led consortium cleared for due diligence
news.summary: Pakistan's Privatisation Commission Board, at its 258th meeting, prequalified 10 of 12 submitted EOIs to proceed to the next stage (including Virtual Data Room access for buy-side due diligence) in the sale of Faisalabad Electric Supply Company (FESCO), per ProPakistani (published Aug 28, 2026) and Arab News PK. Shortlisted parties include three Turkish firms (Aktor Elektrik Enerji Yatirimlari, Genvera Enerji, Cengiz Enerji) plus a consortium of Lucky Cement (PSX: LUCK), Kohat Cement (PSX: KOHC), Hub Power Holdings and Metro Ventures, as well as Sapphire Fibres (PSX: SFL, already logged Aug 25 RSOQ item) and Engro Energy. No transaction value or bid amount disclosed; still a due-diligence/pre-bid stage. Relates to the already-logged Aug 22 Cabinet restructuring-plan approval for FESCO/GEPCO/IESCO. Tagged to the union of the superseded SFL item's ticker plus new tickers named (LUCK, KOHC). Logged as impact 3 (notable, early-stage privatisation process, no confirmed transaction), per desk criteria Rule 10.
